overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Catalonia 8-Person PureTech Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a spacious and luxurious wellness retreat right in your home. Designed for ultimate relaxation and health benefits, this sauna features 23 PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Carbon heating panels, providing soothing heat that promotes muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Constructed from elegant Natural Canadian Hemlock wood and equipped with a Galaxy Star Color Therapy Lighting System, it creates a serene atmosphere perfect for basements or fitness rooms. With Bluetooth and MP3 connectivity, enjoy a personalized spa-like experience while benefiting from its advanced technology and design.

_raw.Product Ad-Copy: Dynamic Saunas is proud to offer the Catalonia which is wheelchair accessible and features the PureTech™ Ultra Low EMF FAR infrared heating panels. When the benches are removed, the sauna becomes a yoga studio. Constructed with the environment in mind, our saunas are made with reforested Canadian Hemlock planks that surpass industry standards, thus producing a quality sauna that retains heat more efficiently, heats up faster and uses less energy in the process.
